name: Frequent amendments or letter of credit changes
description: Repeated changes to beneficiaries, payment terms or amounts shortly before payment.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)
ICC, BAFT and Wolfsberg Group, Trade Finance Principles (2019 update)
